required.quote: A dentist must complete at least twenty (20) credit hours in continuing education courses each license period.

hours_per_period.quote: A dentist must complete at least twenty (20) credit hours in continuing education courses each license period.

period_years.quote: "license period" means the two (2) year period beginning on March 2, 1992, and every two (2) years thereafter.

available.quote: The board may issue a license upon payment of a fee, set by the board under section 13 of this chapter, to an applicant who furnishes proof satisfactory to the board that the applicant is a dentist who: (1) is licensed in another state or a province of Canada that has licensing requirements substantially equal to those in effect in Indiana on the date of application

requirements.value: Applicant must be licensed in another state or Canadian province with substantially equal requirements, have practiced dentistry for at least two of the three years preceding application, pass the law examination, and have completed required continuing education hours in the previous two years.
requirements.quote: is licensed in another state or a province of Canada that has licensing requirements substantially equal to those in effect in Indiana on the date of application; (2) has practiced dentistry for at least two (2) of the three (3) years preceding the date of application; (3) passes the law examination administered by the board or an entity approved by the board; (4) has completed the required hours of continuing education in the previous two (2) years

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing dentistry without a valid license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practice dentistry not being at the time a dentist duly licensed to practice as such in this state under this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing or hiring an unlicensed person to practice dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Employ, hire, or procure one who is not duly licensed as a dentist to practice dentistry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Selling or bartering a dental degree, license, or diploma
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Sell or barter, or offer to sell or barter, or, not being lawfully authorized so to do, issue or confer, or offer to issue or confer, any dental degree, license, or any diploma or document conferring

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using a purchased, fraudulently issued, counterfeited, or materially altered diploma or certificate to practice dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use any diploma, certificate, or transcript which has been purchased, fraudulently issued, counterfeited, or materially altered, either as a license or color of license, to practice dentistry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing dentistry under a false or misleading name or under another person's license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practice dentistry under a false name, under a name intended to mislead the public, under the license of another person of the same name, or hold the person out to the public under such a name as a practitioner of dentistry.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Assuming a dental title or degree designation without having it duly conferred
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Assume the title or degree of "Bachelor of Dental Surgery", append the letters "B.D.S.", "D.D.S.", "M.D.S.", or "D.M.D.", to the person's name, or make use of the same

disciplinary_grounds.description: Representing oneself as entitled to practice dentistry without a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Not having been licensed to practice dentistry under the laws of this state, represent that the person is entitled so to practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Falsely impersonating another at a dental examination
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Falsely personate another at any examination to ascertain the preliminary professional education of candidates for dental certificates, dental degrees, or dental licenses

disciplinary_grounds.description: Otherwise violating the dentistry practice act
Failing to comply with the practice act or rules adopted under it
disciplinary_grounds.quote: An individual who is licensed under this article is subject to discipline under IC 25-1-9.

definition_quote.value: A person is practicing dentistry within the meaning of this chapter if the person does any of the following: (1) Uses the word "dentist" or "dental surgeon"... (4) Offers to evaluate, diagnose, prevent, or treat: (A) diseases, disorders, and conditions of the oral cavity and maxillofacial area... using nonsurgical, surgical, or related procedures. (5) Extracts human teeth or corrects malpositions of the teeth or jaws.
definition_quote.quote: A person is practicing dentistry within the meaning of this chapter if the person does any of the following:

value: correction of malpositions of teeth or jaws
use of x-ray images for dental diagnostic purposes
making oral images, impressions, and casts for prosthetic devices
fabrication, repair, or adjustment of prosthetic dentures and appliances

drug_authority.value: Licensed dentists may prescribe drugs necessary in the practice of dentistry; licensed pharmacists may fill such prescriptions. Dentists may administer dental anesthetics. Dentists practicing under a limited voluntary charitable permit may not distribute, dispense, or administer a controlled substance.
drug_authority.quote: Licensed pharmacists of this state may fill prescriptions of licensed dentists of this state for any drug necessary in the practice of dentistry.

sedation_anesthesia_permit_types.quote: A dentist must have a permit to administer: (1) general anesthesia/deep sedation; or (2) moderate sedation using a parenteral route of administration; to a patient.

dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.quote: "Direct supervision" means that a licensed dentist is physically present in the facility when patient care is provided by the dental hygienist. "Prescriptive supervision" means that a licensed dentist is not required to be physically present in the facility when patient care is provided by the dental hygienist

collaborative_agreement_available.quote: "access practice agreement" means an agreement that: (1) is entered into by a licensed dentist and a dental hygienist that allows the dental hygienist to provide preventive dental hygiene services directly to a patient

hygienist_local_anesthesia_certification.quote: a licensed dental hygienist may administer local dental anesthetics under the direct supervision of a licensed dentist under IC 25-14 if the dental hygienist has: (1) completed board approved educational requirements, including cardiopulmonary resuscitation and emergency care training; and (2) received a board issued dental hygiene anesthetic permit.
